races.name: DragonBet Welsh Racing Festival 9th-11th Oct Nursery
races.verdict:
CRYSTAL KRAKEN matched her previous best despite a very slow start when second in a similar contest over C&D 3 weeks ago and she looks up to going one place better on that evidence reunited with Rossa Ryan. Market confidence behind nursery debutantes Lion of Persia and/or Naval Cop would put a different slant on things, however.

  1. CRYSTAL KRAKEN
  2. LION OF PERSIA (IRE)
  3. NAVAL COP

races.name: Eddie & Sandra Hayward Supports Noahs Ark Charity Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WASHINGTON ROYALE has shaped with promise on all 3 starts in stronger company to date, latterly when fifth in a big-field Goodwood maiden 5 weeks ago. Remaining with potential for better still, he shades preference over Irish raider Ischgl who has shown enough himself to think a race of this nature is within his grasp. Beechwood Glory may emerge best of the remainder.

  1. WASHINGTON ROYALE
  2. ISCHGL (IRE)
  3. BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Paving Fields Construction Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PEROLA still needs to confirm himself as effective on turf but the pick of his all-weather exploits suggest he's up to landing a race of this nature and with the return to sprinting a positive back from another break, he could be the answer. Persian Gate rates a likely improver with his debut run under his belt and can provide the chief threat.

  1. PEROLA (FR)
  2. PERSIAN GATE (IRE)
  3. KODICALL (IRE)

races.name: Runtech Ltd Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced 3-y-o ESCAPE MAGIC can make it 2-2 over C&D. Ajrad is feared off a falling mark with Fullstop also of some interest.

  1. ESCAPE MAGIC
  2. AJRAD
  3. FULLSTOP (IRE)

races.name: Runtech Ltd Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Only a handful make any real appeal and ROVINIA is taken to follow up her recent Lingfield success back in a handicap. A Rose Adaay should be in the mix back at this trip, while Lady V makes some each-way appeal with Rossa Ryan in the saddle.

  1. ROVINIA
  2. A ROSE ADAAY
  3. LADY V (IRE)

races.name: LSL Racing Chepstow Mile Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
THANOS wasn't suited by a tactical affair when going for a hat-trick at Newbury and Harry Charlton's 3-y-o is fancied to resume winning ways with this bigger field likely to play more to his strengths. Revelance beat a few of these when winning over C&D last time so is the second choice ahead of Talis Evolvere.

  1. THANOS
  2. REVELANCE
  3. TALIS EVOLVERE (IRE)

races.name: Tom's Big Bike Ride Handicap
races.verdict:
MAGNA could be the answer to a tricky sprint puzzle. Control Room's sole previous success came on soft ground, and she's feared if the worst of the rain arrives. Last year's winner Some Nightmare also needs considering.

  1. MAGNA
  2. CONTROL ROOM
  3. SOME NIGHTMARE (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet Handicap
races.verdict:
GHOST STORY looks interesting back in Class 6 company for the first time since her wide-margin success at Windsor last summer. Irish raider Staywitherjohnny, Meet Me In Meraki, and Liberate all have credible claims in an open-looking finale.

  1. GHOST STORY (IRE)
  2. STAYWITHERJOHNNY (IRE)
  3. MEET ME IN MERAKI

races.name: Squadron Flyer At Aldwark Manor Estate EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARENITE looks capable of better again and can make it third time lucky. Ouragan's second at Newbury is a standout in her 4 starts but it was the only occasion she's tackled turf and she could pose a threat if recapturing that form. Harry Who showed promise as he got the hang of things towards the end of his Thirsk debut and is next on the list.

  1. ARENITE
  2. OURAGAN (IRE)
  3. HARRY WHO (IRE)

races.name: Harrogate Theatre Panto Tickets Now On-Sale Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TIME THIEF appeared to have a bit up his sleeve when making a winning start to his career at Yarmouth and is taken to defy a penalty. The main threat may come from Feelin' Free, who remains open to improvement and any easing of the ground could suit given her Ffos Las debut second came on soft.

  1. TIME THIEF (IRE)
  2. FEELIN' FREE
  3. PEACE BELLE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Ripon Champion Two Yrs Old Trophy Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
ROGUE JEWEL looked good in the Hornblower here on Great St Wilfrid day and can stretch her unbeaten record to 3. Not My Type is another filly who arrives with a 2-2 record and this Cheveley Park entry is second choice ahead of Pure Mint, who won comfortably on his C&D debut and his stable has won this 4 times since 2018.

  1. ROGUE JEWEL (IRE)
  2. NOT MY TYPE
  3. PURE MINT (IRE)

races.name: Ripon Rowels Handicap
races.verdict:
If there is one here which could be well ahead of its mark it is surely twice-raced Karl Burke 3-y-o MAJESTIC DANE. David O'Meara pair Spoken Truth (seemngly preferred by Tudhope) and Mirsky head the dangers. Ed Bethell's new recruit Firefall would also firmly enter calculations if the betting speaks in his favour.

  1. MAJESTIC DANE
  2. SPOKEN TRUTH (IRE)
  3. MIRSKY

races.name: Book Online At ripon-races.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
Oisin Murphy gets the leg up on ROCK OF ENGLAND who might prove the answer to this tricky sprint. Veteran course specialist Mark's Choice is feared most ahead of thriving pair Happier and Thornaby Pearl.

  1. ROCK OF ENGLAND (IRE)
  2. MARK'S CHOICE (IRE)
  3. HAPPIER (IRE)

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Classified Stakes (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LITTLE TED might be good for a fourth C&D success. Trucial Pearl was successful on her previous visit here and did enough to think this sort of trip could be within range when fourth over 9f at Musselburgh last week. Copper And Five completes the shortlist.

  1. LITTLE TED
  2. TRUCIAL PEARL
  3. COPPER AND FIVE

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Classified Stakes (Div 2)
races.verdict:
TEN SIXTY SIX and Back From Dubai look favoured by these terms with the much younger Ten Sixty Six shading the vote. Quirke On Parole is also considered in a race in which few appeal.

  1. TEN SIXTY SIX (IRE)
  2. BACK FROM DUBAI (IRE)
  3. QUIRKE ON PAROLE

races.name: AJA Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
STAR START has a good record in this type of event under this rider, including when winning this race 2 years ago off a similar mark, and his recent efforts suggest he can make another bold bid. Glitter Code and Spirit Catcher head the dangers.

  1. STAR START (IRE)
  2. GLITTER CODE (IRE)
  3. SPIRIT CATCHER (IRE)

races.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This may well prove to be a match between VIETNORM and Wicksey, the former worth another chance to build on a dominant hurdling debut success.

  1. VIETNORM (IRE)
  2. WICKSEY
  3. JAMBEAREE (IRE)

races.name: Campbell & Rowley Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Unexposed HANDMEDOWNASTAR may well improve to make a winning handicap/stable debut. He gets the note over Belvedere Blast, who is potentially well treated on the best of his form from last season. Rauzan is one to consider at a bigger price.

  1. HANDMEDOWNASTAR (IRE)
  2. BELVEDERE BLAST (IRE)
  3. RAUZAN (IRE)

races.name: EWGA Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A tight handicap that could go the way of AL SAYAH, who finished third in a solid handicap at Haydock earlier in the year and looked as good as ever when winning on the Flat last time. The return of Richie McLernon suggests a revival could be in the offing for Imperial Data, and he's feared most off 6 lb lower than when successful in this race last year.

  1. AL SAYAH
  2. IMPERIAL DATA (IRE)
  3. BELLES BENEFIT (IRE)

races.name: Wicks Group Cavendish Cup Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TAMARIND BAY is fancied to enhance the fine recent record in this race of the Bowen team. The main dangers are Grand Clermont and Breizh River, who both arrive in career-best form.

  1. TAMARIND BAY (IRE)
  2. GRAND CLERMONT (FR)
  3. BREIZH RIVER (FR)

races.name: FGH Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KING ROLY went about things much more convincingly in first-time blinkers when capitalising on his reduced mark at Worcester 12 days ago and he looks to hold sound follow-up claims from 5 lb higher. Course specialist Sean Og heads up the dangers, with Jack Sprat and Karnaval Point completing the shortlist.

  1. KING ROLY
  2. SEAN OG (IRE)
  3. JACK SPRAT (IRE)

races.name: Furness RDA Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
His recent form is uninspiring but CUZCO DU MATHAN is now 17 lb lower in the weights than when winning this race 2 years ago and a revival wouldn't be a surprise. Worcester winner Getaway Jewel is the obvious alternative.

  1. CUZCO DU MATHAN (FR)
  2. GETAWAY JEWEL (IRE)
  3. GHASHAM (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Turbo Boost' Handicap
races.verdict:
TWIRLER was only narrowly denied by a younger rival here on her penultimate outing and can be given another chance to build on that having found herself trapped behind a wall of horses at Brighton last week. Harry's Halo remains on a competitive mark and is respected after a break, while Lingfield winner Logi Bear completes the shortlist in a competitive affair.

  1. TWIRLER
  2. HARRY'S HALO (IRE)
  3. LOGI BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SUMMER TRIANGLE sets a clear standard on her 2 placed efforts, including over C&D. Angel of Desire had some potentially-useful types ahead of her on debut and should improve, with Artemis Star taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. SUMMER TRIANGLE
  2. ANGEL OF DESIRE
  3. ARTEMIS STAR

races.name: Betfred 'The Classic Bookmaker' Handicap
races.verdict:
VELVET RHYTHM should prove well suited by the test provided by Epsom and can take this step up in grade in her stride to record a fifth win of the season. Do Bronxs is a reliable sort who should give his running again, with Aurora Majesty also considered in a race where cases can be made for the majority.

  1. VELVET RHYTHM
  2. DO BRONXS (IRE)
  3. AURORA MAJESTY (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Nifty 50' Amateurs' Derby Handicap (Gentleman Amateur Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
EDWARD SEXTON is very lightly raced on the Flat but mixed it with some smart sorts in bumpers and still looks ahead of his mark having been raised 5 lb for his Haydock win. Crooked Path made a successful start for the Owen yard last time and has to be feared given his handler's record with new recruits, while Divine Knight has been expensive to follow since joining William Haggas but has the eye-catching booking of Henry Callan.

  1. EDWARD SEXTON (IRE)
  2. CROOKED PATH (IRE)
  3. DIVINE KNIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Stanley Wootton Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DOUBLE RED ran well to make the frame over C&D last month and backed that up by going close at Salisbury, so gets the nod to register a second win of the season with the drop back in trip looking in his favour. Sail On Sailor was below expectations at Sandown last time but can be given another chance to resume his progress, with Almekarem also considered.

  1. DOUBLE RED
  2. SAIL ON SAILOR
  3. ALMEKAREM (IRE)

races.name: Geoff Lewis Handicap
races.verdict:
Not a race for maximum confidence but EDUARDO CALDERON returned to form at Kempton 2 weeks ago and a repeat of that might be enough to see him score if coping with the additional 1f. Super Hit might race more efficiently if allowed his head over this shorter trip, and Amused can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. EDUARDO CALDERON (IRE)
  2. SUPER HIT (FR)
  3. AMUSED (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Play Fred's 5 Million' Handicap
races.verdict:
FRENCH AFFAIR has flourished since joining Jennie Candlish and can bring up the hat-trick at the chief expense of Play Me and Silver Trumpet, both of whom have already scored over C&D this summer.

  1. FRENCH AFFAIR (IRE)
  2. PLAY ME
  3. SILVER TRUMPET

races.name: Oktoberfest 3rd And 10th October Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COSMIC MYSTERY ran to a fairly useful level when bumping into a subsequent winner at Nottingham early last month and having been out of her depth at listed level since, Archie Watson's filly is expected to take some catching. Delighfully Hot, Kokumi and Sioux Moon all ran at Chepstow just under a fortnight ago and they look the main threats in that order.

  1. COSMIC MYSTERY
  2. DELIGHFULLY HOT
  3. KOKUMI (FR)

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap
races.verdict:
BLUE TULIP should see out this longer trip and is given the vote with first-time headgear fitted. Le Rouge Chinois can maintain her recent run of good form at the expense of the similarly in-form Sound Gloria.

  1. BLUE TULIP (IRE)
  2. LE ROUGE CHINOIS (DEN)
  3. SOUND GLORIA

races.name: Winter Ladies Evening Sat 28th November Handicap
races.verdict:
A couple of 3-y-os make most appeal with FAEBERON taken to make a winning return to the all-weather at the expense of Saxophonist. Veteran Bearwith can see out the places, with Everyoneknowsadave another to consider.

  1. FAEBERON (IRE)
  2. SAXOPHONIST (IRE)
  3. BEARWITH

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several, but the vote goes to JUST TYPICAL, who has dipped below his last winning mark and with a strong gallop likely, Ian Williams' 5-y-o can open his account for the campaign reunited with Billy Loughnane. Izzari stopped the slide from a tumbling mark when runner-up at Carlisle last time, so he can provide most resistance, with Aim For The Bull rounding off the shortlist back from a break.

  1. JUST TYPICAL
  2. IZZARI (GER)
  3. AIM FOR THE BULL (IRE)

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference & Events Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TEST RUN is by no means the most solid option here but there's certainly a strong case to say he's well treated on his debut form. He's therefore awarded the tentative vote over Filly Eilish and Vega Storm.

  1. TEST RUN
  2. FILLY EILISH (IRE)
  3. VEGA STORM (IRE)

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference & Events Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks trappy but preference is for BALLYBUNION, who showed there's still better to come from him at Wolverhampton on penultimate start and his latest effort was more of a sideways step upped to this trip. He can get off the mark at the expense of Kiani King, who produced his best effort over C&D 5 weeks ago and can build on that here. Roi de Coeur looks best of the remainder.

  1. BALLYBUNION (IRE)
  2. KIANI KING (IRE)
  3. ROI DE COEUR (IRE)

races.name: Gents Evening Saturday 24th October Handicap
races.verdict:
Having caught the eye at Wolverhampton last time, TRAVEL AGENT looks a major player having eased to his last successful mark. Dicko The Legend and Thunderous Love are also well weighted these days and are feared most.

  1. TRAVEL AGENT (IRE)
  2. DICKO THE LEGEND (IRE)
  3. THUNDEROUS LOVE

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
SURGEON COMMANDER was better than ever when recording his third win at Newcastle in June and with the return to 6f not expected to pose a problem, he may prove too streetwise for these. Yes Waliim is an obvious threat, with Society Charm the potential improver in the line up.

  1. SURGEON COMMANDER (IRE)
  2. YES WALIIM (IRE)
  3. SOCIETY CHARM

races.name: Randox Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
EURO AGENT took a big step forward when second here in June and can go one better in this thin maiden. Noel Kelly's pair Mr Caulfield and Fox Walk are respected, while Tullynakill is bred for the job and worth a look on debut.

  1. EURO AGENT (IRE)
  2. MR CAULFIELD (IRE)
  3. FOX WALK (IRE)

races.name: WillWeGo.com Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
PAHLAVI can win this for the second year running and also provide Shark Hanlon with a hat-trick of wins in this contest. He Who Dares has continued in good form on the Flat since his Wexford hurdle success and is feared most ahead of the consistent Granlahan. Gordon Elliott handicap newcomer Youknowthecode would also need considering if the betting speaks in his favour.

  1. PAHLAVI (IRE)
  2. HE WHO DARES (IRE)
  3. GRANLAHAN (IRE)

races.name: North Down Marquees Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
CODED WELDER has been leaving his backers disappointed but this looks a great opportunity for him to open his account judged on his form in handicaps. Majestic Horizon is the obvious danger, with Ritz Plan having a bit to prove.

  1. CODED WELDER (IRE)
  2. MAJESTIC HORIZON (IRE)
  3. RITZ PLAN (IRE)

races.name: AJC Group Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TELL NOBODY NOTHIN was placed off 5 lb higher over hurdles last spring so might be worth chancing now back over the smaller obstacles. Down Around had the run of the race when winning at Ballinrobe last time but could easily have more to come for new trainer Gordon Elliott and is second choice ahead of the other Noel Meade runner Mickey Cohen.

  1. TELL NOBODY NOTHIN (IRE)
  2. DOWN AROUND (IRE)
  3. MICKEY COHEN (IRE)

races.name: Cosy Group Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
KILLEEMORE LAD has returned from a layoff in fine fettle and can get off the mark over fences now. Herja was a fine second in a competitive handicap chase at the Galway Festival last time and is feared most ahead of chase newcomer Jabbar.

  1. KILLEEMORE LAD (IRE)
  2. HERJA (IRE)
  3. JABBAR (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
THE COBBLERS WIFE showed much-improved form starting out for this yard when landing a gamble over hurdles at Tramore and she remains of interest going chasing for the first time. Fellow chasing newcomer Run For The Border is a potential threat, while King's Son shaped well for a long way at Roscommon.

  1. THE COBBLERS WIFE (IRE)
  2. RUN FOR THE BORDER (IRE)
  3. KING'S SON (FR)

races.name: Downpatrick Racecourse Style Awards Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE has thrived for the switch to Declan Queally and can complete a hat-trick under Kevin Healy. Beggars Rock is the other last-time-out winner in the field and probably the danger.

  1. RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE)
  2. BEGGARS ROCK (IRE)
  3. FINNIANS ROW (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Race
races.verdict:
RULER'S CONTROL will need to settle better than he did in Group 2 company at Goodwood 5 weeks ago but a repeat of his Windsor Castle fourth gives him sound claims down in class and he's selected to capitalise. South Dakota shaped better than the distance beaten suggests in the Ballyhane Stakes and is feared along with Full Volume and Joga Bonito.

  1. RULER'S CONTROL (IRE)
  2. SOUTH DAKOTA (IRE)
  3. FULL VOLUME (FR)

races.name: Elphin Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
BULLET BOURBON will handle the ground and is taken to resume winning ways back over 7f. La Campanella and Angel of Promise head the dangers in a wide-open handicap.

  1. BULLET BOURBON (IRE)
  2. LA CAMPANELLA (IRE)
  3. ANGEL OF PROMISE (IRE)

races.name: Lidan Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty in with a squeak but the vote goes to MERISI DIAMOND, who scrambled home at the Curragh back in April and Thomas Coyle's 7-y-o remains on a handy mark after just a 2 lb nudge. Provided he's ready to roll, he can enhance his good record here at the expense of another track-specialist Earls, with Ninth Crusade and Highbury See See a couple worthy of consideration, too.

  1. MERISI DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. EARLS (IRE)
  3. NINTH CRUSADE (IRE)

races.name: Lecarrow Race
races.verdict:
HAZDANN clearly hasn't been the easiest to train, but this looks a good opportunity to double his tally. Joseph O'Brien's Sinmara and Dial Me In are the most likely dangers.

  1. HAZDANN (IRE)
  2. SINMARA
  3. DIAL ME IN (IRE)

races.name: Racing Here Again On September 28th Maiden
races.verdict:
ALMAZANN stands out on form and is the clear pick to open his account. Plug In Hybrid showed potential on debut and is of interest over this longer trip, while Mawhibah and Miss Romagna appeal most of the remainder.

  1. ALMAZANN (IRE)
  2. PLUG IN HYBRID (IRE)
  3. MAWHIBAH (QA)

races.name: Oran Handicap
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff but FRATAS hasn't been with her excellent yard for long and given a short break, she makes plenty of appeal. Youcansaythatagain and Stellar Moment bring unexposed profiles to the table and they are a couple of potential threats.

  1. FRATAS (IRE)
  2. YOUCANSAYTHATAGAIN (IRE)
  3. STELLAR MOMENT (IRE)

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse On Facebook Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
AUGUSTA ROCK has taken a step forward on his last 2 outings and he can go one better than at Down Royal last month to score for the all-conquering Joseph O'Brien yard. Top weights Glen Echo and Nathema are considered, with Canon Law also likely to have a say.

  1. AUGUSTA ROCK (IRE)
  2. GLEN ECHO (IRE)
  3. NATHEMA

races.name: Prix Normandise Pet Food - Vire Normandi - Attele
Prix E. Leclerc - Vire Normandie - Monte
Prix Sk Pro - Vire Normandie - Attele
